name: Autonomous Economic Discovery Control Plane
northstar: Use Seesaw to discover migrating scarcity, choose the cheapest real feedback world, UNDERENGINEER the minimum live intervention, accumulate scarce consequential state, and reserve the human for strategic direction, physical access, trust and bounded authority.
strategic_invariant: Can OpenAI destroy this merely by writing more software? If yes, demote it to infrastructure. If no, name the scarce external state and measure its accretion.
underengineer_invariant: UNDERENGINEER: for the highest-value thesis, find the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state. Build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification; then stop and observe.
invariants: Cognition and interfaces are assumed to commoditize; consequential external state does not.
Infrastructure is pulled by scarce-asset campaigns and does not compete with them as a business.
No checkpoint is complete because an agent says done.
A self-reported live event is a CLAIM, never PROVEN evidence.
GitHub code presence is not behavioral proof.
Only independently attested active probes, signed receipts, external readbacks or real economic outcomes may produce PROVEN.
UNDERENGINEER chooses the earliest moat-producing live event, not the smallest codebase.
After the first real moat event, pause feature expansion and update the thesis from evidence.
ATask owns execution facts; Seed0 owns comparative learning; QP owns truth/authority transitions.
reward_objective: For asset campaigns maximize ΔControlledScarceState × EvidenceStrength × EconomicValue per human-minute/cost/risk. For infrastructure maximize scarce-asset campaign enablement per resource.

projects.name: AgentCom UK Business Onboarding
projects.one_liner: Show a UK SMB how it appears to ChatGPT, then make the company machine-readable and safely operable through ChatGPT.
projects.minimal_live_product: Onboard one UK trade business for free, identify its single highest-frequency pain, expose that one workflow through ChatGPT, obtain the minimum delegated permission, execute one real bounded case, and measure the outcome. No separate SMB dashboard.

projects.name: Astra / ChatGPT Capability Factory
projects.one_liner: Discover economically useful capabilities, mine GitHub before coding, assemble them, validate them, then compile them into ChatGPT/MCP/web/API surfaces.
projects.minimal_live_product: Given an already-owned scarce asset and behavior contract, search existing components, assemble the smallest interface, and pass one active capability probe.

projects.name: BreadUp
projects.one_liner: Photograph an object and turn it into optimized commerce; then expand upstream into demand sensing and agent-to-agent selling.
projects.minimal_live_product: One seller photographs one item; BreadUp creates and publishes one listing on one marketplace with approval, then captures the final sale/no-sale outcome, fees and time-to-sale.

projects.name: Cmail Identity + Social Onboarding
projects.one_liner: Provision the reusable identity surface every agent-operated business needs: domain, DNS, email, phone and handles.
projects.minimal_live_product: For one real business/campaign, obtain delegated DNS or email authority and complete one externally verifiable change without exposing credentials to the worker.

projects.name: Campaign Control Plane
projects.one_liner: The executable portfolio dashboard that turns frozen theses into deterministic checkpoint DAGs and autonomous build experiments.
projects.minimal_live_product: One campaign page that can choose a live moat event, dispatch one ATask, ingest independently attested evidence, surface one H-task, and commit one QP receipt.

projects.name: Pinterest + Etsy Demand Sensing
projects.one_liner: Treat Pinterest, Etsy, TikTok, Shopify and marketplaces as revealed-demand sensors feeding grounded campaign graphs.
projects.minimal_live_product: Track one source family for one product decision, make one explicit prediction/action, then attach the real listing/campaign outcome. No broad dashboard.

projects.name: GeoDrop
projects.one_liner: Build proprietary, timestamped installed-base reality data where public maps are insufficient.
projects.minimal_live_product: Choose one country/region and one asset class (initial example: UK EV charging hardware). Verify a small set of installations with timestamped source/evidence and expose a query a buyer could actually use.

projects.name: Pog.pet
projects.one_liner: A personalized physical pet product that makes the customer’s pet come alive on their phone and becomes a persistent Pog actor.
projects.minimal_live_product: Sell one simple personalized pet product: customer uploads pet photo, receives a durable web actor/animation link with persistent pet ID, optionally printed as a card. AR and complex rigging wait.

projects.name: Pogtown
projects.one_liner: One shared AI-native world protocol with phone AR, browser 3D, VR and live-show views.
projects.minimal_live_product: A tiny browser runtime with a strict game-pack schema: an agent can submit/generate a game, deterministic validation accepts it, humans join a room and play it, and session/Pog events are recorded.

projects.name: QP / A-COM
projects.one_liner: The deterministic authority and truth kernel beneath autonomous work.
projects.minimal_live_product: One action, one grant, one deterministic gate, one credential-brokered execution and one signed transition receipt. Do not expand the instruction set first.

projects.name: Security / Safe Autonomous Execution
projects.one_liner: Make secret leakage, prompt-injected tool calls, unsafe egress and unauthorized side effects deterministic build failures.
projects.minimal_live_product: Put a deterministic capability/secret/egress gate in front of one live autonomous campaign action, run a small adversarial battery, and store the blocked/allowed result with adjudication.

projects.name: Seesaw Market Lab
projects.one_liner: Use frozen paper-market hypotheses as the fastest numerical laboratory for Seesaw causal discovery.
projects.minimal_live_product: Freeze one Seesaw thesis, open a zero-capital paper position, define benchmark/horizon/falsifier, resolve it from external data, and append one immutable scored row.

projects.name: XMRbot Private Commerce
projects.one_liner: A private agent that discovers, negotiates and acquires goods/services through XMR-native rails while exposing ordinary agent interfaces.
projects.minimal_live_product: Use one marketplace/service only: search a legitimate item/service, normalize offer, communicate/possibly negotiate, require human approval/signing for payment, and record escrow/settlement/delivery outcome.

shared_components.name: ATask kernel
shared_components.role: Goal/task/proof/human boundary; externally validated claims; run accounting.
shared_components.boundary: No planning intelligence. Owns factual execution state and bounded H-task interface.

shared_components.name: Seed0
shared_components.role: Project-shape standard, tournament harness, multi-seed experiments and learning candidates.
shared_components.boundary: Learns from runs and compares implementations; does not redefine truth or authority.

shared_components.name: QP / A-COM
shared_components.role: Deterministic gates, grants, receipts, proof levels, authority for consequential actions.
shared_components.boundary: Cognition is untrusted; canonical state and external effects require gates/grants.

shared_components.name: Cmail
shared_components.role: Reusable company identity acquisition: domain, email, phone, handles and onboarding adapters.
shared_components.boundary: Credentials are references; consequential calls flow through QP capability grants.

shared_components.name: Security gate
shared_components.role: Secret scanning, untrusted-repo preflight, egress/action policy, prompt-injection regressions.
shared_components.boundary: Security checks are deterministic gates, not LLM assurances.

shared_components.name: Demand sensing
shared_components.role: Reusable source→normalized record→typed signal pipeline for Pinterest/Etsy/TikTok/Shopify/marketplace signals.
shared_components.boundary: Signals are evidence; they do not directly authorize spend or publishing.

shared_components.name: ChatGPT capability surface
shared_components.role: Compile capabilities into ChatGPT-native/MCP/app surfaces plus web/API/x402 variants.
shared_components.boundary: Surface is downstream of a tested capability contract.

shared_components.name: UNDERENGINEER
shared_components.role: High-level project manager: pick the earliest real moat event and build only the prerequisites, safety and verification needed to reach it.
shared_components.boundary: Never optimizes for smallest codebase. Optimizes for shortest credible path to controlled scarce-state accretion and then pauses for evidence.

shared_components.name: WORLD_SELECT
shared_components.role: Select the cheapest real experiment world capable of changing the decision.
shared_components.boundary: Simulation can rank worlds; only external evidence resolves real-world claims.

shared_components.name: PORTFOLIO Scheduler
shared_components.role: Allocate scarce experiment resources across fast truth, fast demand, economic and deep scarce-state lanes.
shared_components.boundary: Cannot invent capacity or bypass account/human/QP constraints.

shared_components.name: Strategic H-Task Desk
shared_components.role: Surface only bounded strategic, physical, KYC/spend and trust/relationship questions that machines cannot validly close.
shared_components.boundary: Implementation/debugging questions must stay with agents when a machine test exists.

shared_components.name: BreadUp Self-Lab
shared_components.role: Use our own opportunity→probe→outcome dataset loop before selling the intelligence to BreadUp users.

operating_model: Many cheap experiments run through shared deterministic infrastructure. Performance and resource bottlenecks select what scales; infrastructure is pulled by experiments rather than self-prioritized.
human_endgame: The human desk answers bounded strategic questions, performs inaccessible physical/platform/relationship H-tasks, and grants consequential authority. Agents own search, coding, testing, simulation, monitoring, iteration and evidence packaging.
feedback_invariant: Simulations rank. External worlds resolve. Only independently evidenced real outcomes may graduate demand/economic/scarce-state claims.
resource_invariant: Accounts, stores, money, permissions and human attention are explicit bottlenecks; autonomous software cannot assume infinite parallel access.
